Sub.:  Audio & Video Recording link of Analysts’ & Institutional Investors’ Meet 
held on 18th May, 2026 
Dear Sir, 
In terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, this is to inform that Analysts’ & 
Institutional Investors’ Meet (‘Meet’) was organized by POWERGRID on Monday, 
18th  May, 2026, at 11:30 A.M. (IST) at Mumbai, wherein Senior Management team 
discussed the Company’s business and outlook post the declaration of audited financial 
results for 4th quarter & financial year ended 31st March, 2026 and interacted with the 
Investors & Analysts.  
Links for accessing Audio & Video recording of the Meet are as under: 
Audio Link: https://apps.powergrid.in/pgdocs/2026/05/Power%20Grid%20Analysts%20Meet%20Audio%2018.05.2026.mp3 
Video Link: https://apps.powergrid.in/pgdocs/2026/05/Power%20Grid%20Analysts'%20&%20Institutional%20Investors'%20Meet.mp4 
Thanking You, 
Yours faithfully, 
(Satyaprakash Dash) 
Company Secretary & 
Compliance Officer
